title: O, for the Death of Those
description: O, for the Death of Those in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 604 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Peaceful Death of the Righteous”, where the book credits them to the Ch. Psalmody.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O, for the death of those Who slum-ber in the Lord! O, be like theirs my last re-pose, Like theirs my last re-ward!

lines: O, for the death of those
O, be like theirs my last repose,
On wings of faith and love,
To meet the Saviour they adore,
With us their names shall live
Embalmed with all our hearts can give, —

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
